evals.prompt: Author a fail-closed Runx issue-flow policy from this governance brief.
evals.expected_output: Return a native-policy-validated contract covering sources, owners, merge authority, and close-after-verification rules.

evals.prompt: Prepare an issue-flow policy from this approved governance brief. Preserve the stated governance; identify any concrete bindings still needed before a policy can be compiled.
evals.expected_output: Return needs_input with policy null and native validation not_run because the brief omits concrete source locators/actions, automation definitions and their repository mappings. Retain the supplied repositories, source kinds, owners, human-merge requirement and close-after-verification constraint while asking for the missing bindings.
expectations: Do not weaken or reinterpret the supplied merge and closure constraints.
Do not invent source locators, source actions, automation identities or allowed actions to manufacture a ready policy.
Return needs_input and policy null; do not claim native validation passed or that a policy was installed.
